hook: A boy and his dad were caught in big surf.
narration: A boy and his father were stuck in the surf when this wave broke over them.
Big waves were rolling into the Oregon coast near Pacific City.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from North Bend lowered a rescue swimmer to them.
Rip currents can pull a person out faster than an Olympic swimmer can swim back.
The swimmer got them onto the cable, [short pause] one at a time.
outcome: The crew hoisted the boy and his father up into the helicopter.
title: Boy and dad caught in Oregon surf
description:
A Coast Guard HH-65C Dolphin crew from Air Station North Bend rescued an 11-year-old boy and his father caught in the surf near Pacific City, Oregon, on March 26, 2010.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Group North Bend, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/81932/coast-guard-rescues-father-and-son-surf-near-pacific-city-ore
